title: Morph Icon
description: A stroke icon that morphs into the next one on a spring when its icon changes: matched strokes rotate and glide, the rest split or merge. Takes any 24x24 stroke icon data. No dependencies.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon to show: a `[tag, attrs][]` node list (path, line, circle, ellipse, rect, polyline, polygon on a 24x24 grid, like Lucide's) or a raw path `d`. Change it to morph.

props.name: from / to / progress
props.description: Controlled mode: the pair frozen at `progress` (0 to 1), no spring. For scrubbing, gestures and scroll. Wins over `icon` while both ends are set.

props.name: reducedMotion
props.description: "user" swaps without motion while the visitor prefers reduced motion; "never" always animates (upstream's default); "always" always swaps.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the SVG.

props.name: absoluteStrokeWidth
props.description: Keep the stroke width constant in pixels when `size` changes, as in lucide-react.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. With it the SVG is `role="img"` with a `<title>`; without it the SVG is hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: ref
props.description: Imperative control: morph or jump to an icon without changing props.

a11y: Decorative by default: without `label` the SVG is aria-hidden, so put the accessible name on the control around it (the demo's toggles are native buttons with aria-label and aria-pressed).
With `label` it is role="img" with a <title>.
Honors prefers-reduced-motion by default (`reducedMotion="user"`): the icon swaps without the morph. Upstream animates regardless unless asked.
docs:
Installed `MorphIcon` (`@/components/ui/morph-icon`) with its driver (`morph-icon-dom`) and its geometry core (`morph-icon-core`). No dependencies.

```tsx
import { MorphIcon, type IconNode } from "@/components/ui/morph-icon";

const menu: IconNode = [["path", { d: "M4 5h16" }], ["path", { d: "M4 12h16" }], ["path", { d: "M4 19h16" }]];
const close: IconNode = [["path", { d: "M18 6 6 18" }], ["path", { d: "m6 6 12 12" }]];

<button type="button" aria-label="Menu" aria-pressed={open} onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>
  <MorphIcon icon={open ? close : menu} />
</button>
```

Change `icon` to morph. Icons are data, not components: pass a `[tag, attrs]` node list or a path `d` for any stroke-drawn icon on a 24x24 grid (Lucide's icon nodes, or your own). Filled glyphs do not morph cleanly. `from`, `to` and `progress` freeze a morph for scrubbing. Motion follows `prefers-reduced-motion` by default.
